Respondents
 Prayer:

Writ petition is filed under Article 226 of th
 Constitution of India, to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing
 the 1st respondent - Collector or the 2nd respondent - Dro to
 consider the petitioner's representation dated 07.7.2023 and
 hear the petitioner on the grievance in respect of fixing fair
 compensation to petitioner's house site, i.e. 226 sq.mt.
 presently bearing Plot No. 7.B, Town Survey No. 32/79, Ward

 District and to pass appropriate orders 
 compensation under the Right to Fair Compensation and
 Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilita
 Resettlement Act, 2013 (Central Act, 30/2013) within a time
 limit to be fixed by this Court.
For Petitioner : Mr.G.Rajaguru

For Respondents : Mr.C.Sathish,
 Government Advocate.

* * *
 Order
Heard both sides.
2. The petition-mentioned land belonged to the petitioner.
Acquisition proceedings took place.
When the petitioner was minor, his mother is said to have given consent.
Compensation is yet to be paid.
The respondents propose to hold an enquiry on 22.11.2023 at 11.30 a.m.
On the said date, the petitioner shall be present in the office of the fourth respondent.
Award shall be passed within a period of three weeks thereafter.
The award amount shall be disbursed to the petitioner within a period of two weeks after passing of the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis award.
The petitioner can very well receive the same without prejudice to his claim to seek higher compensation.
3. This writ petition stands allowed on these terms.
No costs.
